mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,kind,board_key AS board,title,content,excerpt,tags,CAST(author_account_id AS CHAR) AS authorAccountId, author_name AS authorName,reward,CAST(cover_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS coverAttachmentId,replies_count AS replies, views_count AS views,likes_count AS likes,pinned,solved,recommended, DATE_FORMAT(recommended_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS recommendedAt,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt

CAST(account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,username,nickname,bio,location,website,points,experience,threads_count AS threadsCount, likes_received AS likesReceived,CAST(avatar_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS avatarAttachmentId,CAST(cover_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS coverAttachmentId
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM forum_thread WHERE deleted=0 AND kind=#{kind} AND board_key=#{board} AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR excerpt LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND recommended=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forum_follow f WHERE f.account_id=#{accountId} AND f.followed_account_id=forum_thread.author_account_id)
ORDER BY (likes_count+replies_count*2) DESC,created_at DESC ORDER BY recommended_at DESC,created_at DESC ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT FROM forum_thread WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_thread WHERE board_key=#{board} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_thread SET views_count=views_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(c.thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,CAST(c.author_account_id AS CHAR) AS authorAccountId,c.author_name AS authorName,c.content, CAST(c.parent_comment_id AS CHAR) AS parentCommentId,c.likes_count AS likes,c.deleted, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM forum_comment c WHERE c.thread_id=#{threadId} AND (c.deleted=0 OR (c.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM forum_comment r WHERE r.parent_comment_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0))) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,CAST(author_account_id AS CHAR) AS authorAccountId,author_name AS authorName,content, CAST(parent_comment_id AS CHAR) AS parentCommentId,likes_count AS likes,deleted, DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM forum_comment WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_thread SET replies_count=replies_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
DELETE FROM forum_like WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_like WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_favorite WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND thread_id=#{threadId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_member(account_id,username) VALUES(#{accountId},#{username}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username=VALUES(username)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM forum_member WHERE account_id=#{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_member SET points=points+#{delta} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND points+#{delta}>=0
UPDATE forum_member SET threads_count=threads_count+1 WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
UPDATE forum_member SET experience=experience+#{delta} WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,change_points AS changePoints,balance,biz_type AS bizType,biz_id AS bizId,remark, DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM forum_point_log WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_checkin WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND checkin_date=CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_checkin WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_lottery_log WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND created_at>=CURDATE()
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,name,category,description,points,stock,icon,image_url AS imageUrl,min_level AS minLevel FROM forum_gift WHERE status=1 ORDER BY points,id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,name,category,description,points,stock,icon,image_url AS imageUrl,min_level AS minLevel,status FROM forum_gift ORDER BY status DESC,points,id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,name,category,description,points,stock,icon,image_url AS imageUrl,min_level AS minLevel,status FROM forum_gift WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,name,category,description,points,stock,icon,image_url AS imageUrl,min_level AS minLevel,status FROM forum_gift WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_gift SET stock=stock-1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND stock>0
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(e.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(e.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,COALESCE(m.username,'') AS username,e.gift_name AS giftName,e.points, COALESCE(e.source,'EXCHANGE') AS source,e.status, e.tracking_no AS trackingNo,DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,e.issued_by_name AS issuedByName, DATE_FORMAT(e.issued_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS issuedAt,e.issue_remark AS issueRemark FROM forum_exchange e LEFT JOIN forum_member m ON m.account_id=e.account_id WHERE e.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
